video:video.video:title: The Mediterranean's warming waters are drawing hundreds of invasive species
video:video.video:description: Scientists claimed that climate change, caused mainly by burning oil, coal and gas, is making the Mediterranean Sea hotter, bringing hundreds of new and invasive fish species that decimate indigenous populations.

video:video.video:title: Ebola outbreak is worsening food insecurity in eastern Congo, UN agency chief warns
video:video.video:description: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo is worsening food insecurity in a country already battling with one of the world's largest humanitarian crises, the head of the U.N. food agency said Wednesday.

video:video.video:title: Cricket legend Sir Garfield Sobers honored by Barbados at state funeral in Bridgetown
video:video.video:description: A full state funeral for cricket legend and Barbadian National Hero Sir Garfield Sobers was held on Wednesday at the Kensington Oval in Bridgetown, Barbados.

video:video.video:title: Search and rescue operation continues at paper factory in quake-hit southern Japan
video:video.video:description: A search and rescue operation continued after a chimney collapse at a Nippon Paper Industries factory in Kumamoto after a powerful earthquake hit the area killing at least 23 people in southwestern Japan.

video:video.video:title: Dramatic video captures teen lifeguard rescuing a child from 8-to-10-foot waves
video:video.video:description: A 16-year-old California State Parks lifeguard rescued a 10-year-old boy from 8-to-10-foot waves at Seabright State Beach in Santa Cruz.

video:video.video:title: Hiker treks to safety after impaling himself on trekking pole in Montana
video:video.video:description: David Cifaldi and his two hiking companions were crossing Montana's ominous Froze-to-Death Plateau and approaching the top of the state's highest peak when their adventure took a bizarre and dangerous turn: Cifaldi slipped and impaled himself on his trekking pole as he fell.

video:video.video:title: Two firefighters die in wildfire on southern Greek island of Crete
video:video.video:description: Two firefighters have died in a wildfire that broke out Wednesday on the southern Greek island of Crete, the fire department said.

video:video.video:title: Aerial video shows extensive damage two days after earthquake hit southern Japan
video:video.video:description: Rural communities in southwestern Japan were struggling to get their lives back to normal Thursday, two days after a powerful earthquake set off an explosion at a mall, toppled a factory chimney and flattened homes, killing at least 23 people.
